description: Search wines by type, name, winery, country, or region. All data sourced from a public wine database — no API key required.

filterCountry.description: Only return wines from this country (e.g. 'France', 'Italy', 'United States'). Case-insensitive partial match.
filterCountry.title: Filter by country

filterRegion.description: Only return wines from this region (e.g. 'Bordeaux', 'Napa Valley', 'Tuscany'). Case-insensitive partial match.
filterRegion.title: Filter by region

filterWinery.description: Only return wines from this winery. Case-insensitive partial match.
filterWinery.title: Filter by winery

minRating.description: Only return wines with a community rating at or above this value (1.0–5.0).
minRating.title: Minimum rating

enumTitles: Browse by wine type (reds, whites, sparkling, rosé, dessert, port)
Get all wines across all types
mode.title: Mode

searchQuery.description: Free-text query matched against wine name and winery (mode=search). Example: 'cabernet' or 'bordeaux'.
searchQuery.title: Search query

vintageMax.description: Only return wines with vintage year at or before this value.
vintageMax.title: Vintage year (max)

vintageMin.description: Only return wines with vintage year at or after this value.
vintageMin.title: Vintage year (min)

wineType.description: Wine category to fetch (used in mode=byType and as an optional filter in mode=search/all).
wineType.title: Wine type
